title: Message
description: The state stream from the server to every renderer (desk kiosk and phone), one JSON message per WebSocket frame (CLAUDE.md §4.7). The TypeScript types in renderer/src/protocol.ts are generated from this file (`cd renderer && npm run protocol`); the Python encoder is server/lineage_server/protocol/encode.py. A renderer that meets a message type it does not know ignores it. Bump `protocol` only for a change an older renderer would misread.

SimTime.description: Sim time in milliseconds since the world was created.

Grid.description: A grid of the world's cells, row by row from the top-left cell, as little-endian whole numbers in base64. A cell's value is its number divided by `scale`.

encoding.description: u8: one byte per cell; u16le: two bytes per cell, little-endian.

scale.description: What a cell's whole number is divided by: 1 for classes and bit masks, 255 or 65535 for shares.

ClockMessage.description: Where the world is in time. Sent on connect and then often (every server tick): cheap.

date.description: The calendar date in the world (UTC), YYYY-MM-DD.

season_progress.description: Share of the current season gone by, 0–1.

LandMessage.description: The land and what grows on it, every cell. Sent on connect and whenever it changes (once a sim-day, after the plants grow, and after terrain events). The palette is not sent: the renderer has the report maps' own (renderer/src/terrain/palette.json). Grids: heights: Height of each cell, 0–1 (u16le, scale 65535). cover: Land-cover class of each cell: an index into `cover_classes` (u8, scale 1). biomass: Plant biomass of each cell, 0–1 (u8, scale 255). snow: Depth of lying snow on each cell, 0–1 (u8, scale 255), as the simulation has it from the season and the height. plant_height: HEIGHT gene of the plant on each cell, 0–1 (u8, scale 255); 0 where none grows. plant_evergreen: EVERGREEN gene of the plant on each cell, 0–1 (u8, scale 255); 0 where none grows. plant_rare: Rare genes of the plant on each cell, as a bit mask (u8, scale 1): bit k is `rare_genes[k]`.

world.description: Which world this is: a new continent after an apocalypse has another seed.

cover_classes.description: Land-cover class names, in the order of their numbers in `cover`.

rare_genes.description: Names of the plants' rare genes, bit 0 first.

scorch.description: How recently each cell burnt (R4): 1 just burnt, fading to 0 over [flora] scorch_days. Absent in recordings made before R4.

algae.description: Algae on the shallow sea (M11): biomass 0 to [flora] algae_capacity per cell. Absent before M11.

FaunaMessage.description: What every creature's body is derived from (R2). Sent on connect and when it changes. The renderer derives bodies itself (renderer/src/creatures/phenotype.ts); derived values are never sent.

genes.description: Creature gene names, in genome order.

phenotype_config.description: The [fauna] config keys the phenotype function reads (lineage_sim.fauna.phenotype.CONFIG_KEYS): numbers, and `learning` a boolean.

rare_config.description: The [fauna] config values the renderer needs to draw rare genes (M7, R2): lineage_sim.rare.render_config(cfg), keys rare.RENDER_KEYS (now giant_mass_factor). Empty before rare genes exist.

CreaturesMessage.description: Where every living creature is (R2). Sent after every fauna tick. A creature's genome comes once, the first time its id is sent; an id missing from `ids` has died.

ids.description: Every living creature, by an id it keeps for its life.

positions.description: Where each of `ids` is, in cells: [x, y].

species.description: The species of each of `ids` (M6; 0 for none yet). Absent before species exist.

born.description: Creatures not sent before (all of them on connect): id and genome, genes in `FaunaMessage.genes` order, each 0–1.

slots.description: Its rare genes, as the bits of `RareMessage.genes` of kingdom creature (M7); fixed for life. Absent before rare genes exist.

torpid.description: Ids of the creatures that are torpid now (hibernating, lying still: M7). Absent before rare genes exist.

young.description: The creatures not yet of age (R5): id and how far grown toward coming of age, in sixteenths (0 newborn, 15 nearly grown). Those absent are grown. Absent from streams recorded before R5.

SpeciesMessage.description: Every species that has lived (M6). Sent on connect and when a species is born or dies out.

parent.description: The species it split from; null for one of the first.

RareMessage.description: The rare genes of both kingdoms and how each shows (M7): lineage_sim.rare.signature_table(). Sent on connect. Bits are stable; new genes only append. A creature's genes are the bits of its `slots`, a plant's the bits of `LandMessage.plant_rare`.

bit.description: The gene's bit value in the kingdom's mask (1, 2, 4, …).

signature.description: A key naming the visual signature, for the renderer to draw by.

look.description: What the signature looks like, in words.

ChronicleMessage.description: New lines of the island's history (M9, R3): the chronicle's entries written since the last chronicle message, oldest first. Not sent on connect; a renderer captions the notable ones as they come. The full history is the API's (S3).

notable_importance.description: Entries at this importance and above are notable ([chronicle] notable_importance): the desk captions them.

major_importance.description: Entries at this importance and above are major ([chronicle] major_importance): pushed to the phone (S4).

number.description: The entry's number in the chronicle, from 1.

kind.description: What kind of event it tells of (lineage_sim.chronicle Kind values: speciation, extinction, fire…).

species.description: The species it is about; 0 for none.

x.description: The cell where it happened; -1 when it has no one place.

y.description: The cell where it happened; -1 when it has no one place.

SkyMessage.description: The island's weather of the moment (R4): the light, whether the owner is at the desk, what rain falls, and the cells on fire. Sent on connect and then at every presence tick (10 sim-minutes): the renderer eases the scene's light between them.

light.description: The light of the moment ([presence]: 1 by day, night_light at night, the moonlight floor after a long absence), 0–1.

present.description: Whether the owner is at the desk (the light is rising toward day, or day).

rain.description: What falls now: none; rain, thunder (rain with thunder, seen and heard only) or storm (a thunderstorm, whose lightning sets fires), the island's own weather; or soaking, the rain god power's rain, which puts fires out; or cloud, an overcast sky with nothing falling (seen only).

burning.description: The cells on fire, as indices y × width + x of the land's grid, in increasing order.

EventsMessage.description: What just happened on the island that the scene shows as weather or a sequence (R4), oldest first: fires, volcanoes, earthquakes, craters, god powers, and the end of a world and the beginning of the next. Not sent on connect. After world_ended, every message is of the next world until the next world_ended.

kind.description: fire_started (lightning in a thunderstorm) and fire_ended, volcano, earthquake and crater (the terrain's events), god_power (a power fired), creatures_arrived (newcomers landed: the ark, or strangers), world_ended and world_began (M10).

x.description: The cell where it happened (fire_started, volcano, earthquake, crater, god_power, creatures_arrived).

y.description: The cell where it happened (fire_started, volcano, earthquake, crater, god_power, creatures_arrived).

radius_cells.description: How far it reached, in cells (volcano, earthquake, crater).

power.description: Which power fired (god_power): meteor, rain, seed or ark.

world.description: The world's number, from 1 (world_ended: the one that ended; world_began: the new one).
